messages.subject: Project Sable - Sable House, 40 Deansgate, Manchester (our ref WC-00118)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert,

We act for Thornbury Properties Limited on the proposed purchase of the freehold of Sable House, 40 Deansgate, Manchester (title GM921044) from your client Ardent Property Holdings Limited.

Please let us have the contract pack at your convenience, to include: the draft contract, official copies of the registers and title plan and filed documents, copies of the four occupational leases and any licences, the rent deposit deed, replies to CPSE.1 and CPSE.2, EPCs and the service charge accounts.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
James Osei

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.subject: RE: Project Sable - Sable House, 40 Deansgate, Manchester (our ref WC-00118)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Thank you. We confirm we act for Ardent Property Holdings Limited. Our reference is RPM/AS/4471.

We will let you have the draft contract and the bulk of the pack early next week. The replies to CPSE will follow shortly afterwards. The property is sold with full title guarantee and we are instructed that the sale is to be treated as a TOGC; the seller has opted to tax.

We note the deposit is to be held by us; our client's preference is to hold as agent rather than stakeholder, on which we will revert in the contract.

Kind regards,
Robert Mason
Partner | Calder Whitmore LLP
